scripts.build: npm --prefix code/backend install && npm --prefix code/frontend install && npm --prefix code/frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix code/backend install && npm --prefix code/frontend install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'code/backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'code/frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
